item.title: Aramaki Rose Park
item.description:
I went to Aramaki Rose Park by bicycle. A lot of different roses were blooming in the large and splendid park. Admission is free. Isn’t it something!?

Sprinkler’s water splashed when watering time. Children were excited getting wet. I almost got wet too. I recommend families with children to bring spare clothes.
